sn46.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Sāriputto Sāvatthiyam viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2.
sn46.4:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū amantesi
sn46.4:1.4: Āvuso ti te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ || ||
sn46.4:2.3: satisambojjhaṅgo || dhammavicaya- || viriya- || pīti- || passaddhi- || samādhi- || upekhāsambojjhaṅgo ||
sn46.4:2.5: Imesaṃ khvāham āvuso sattannam bojjhaṅgānaṃ yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharituṃ tena tena bojjhaṅgena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharāmi || ||
sn46.4:2.6: Yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ viharituṃ || tena tena bojjhaṅgena majjhantikaṃ samayaṃ viharāmi || ||
sn46.4:2.7: Yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi sāyanhasamayaṃ viharitum || tena tena bojjhaṅgena sāyanhasamayaṃ viharāmi || || 5.
sn46.4:2.8: Satisambojjhaṅgo iti ce me āvuso hoti || Appamāṇo ti me hoti || Susamāraddho ti me hoti || tiṭṭhantaṃ ca naṃ Tiṭṭhatīti pajānāmi || ||
sn46.4:2.9: Sa ce pi me cavati Idappaccayā me cavatīti pajānāmi || 6-10. || la || 11.
sn46.4:2.10: Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo iti ce me āvuso hoti || Appamāṇo ti me hoti || Susamāraddho ti me hoti || tiṭṭhantaṃ ca naṃ Tiṭṭhatīti pajānāmi || ||
sn46.4:2.11: Sa ce pi me cavati Idappaccayā me cavatīti pajānāmi || || 12.
sn46.4:3.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso rañño vā rājamahāmattassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānam dussakaraṇḍako pūro assa ||
sn46.4:3.2: so yaññadeva dussayugam ākaṅkheyya pubbaṇhasamayam pārupituṃ || taṃ tad eva dussayugam pubbaṇhasamayam pārupeyya || ||
sn46.4:3.3: Yaññad eva dussayuham ākaṅkheyya majjhantikaṃ samayam pārupituṃ || tan tad eva dussayugam majjhantikaṃ samayam pārupeyya || ||
sn46.4:3.4: Yaññadeva dussayugam ākaṅkheyya sāyaṇhasamayam pārupituṃ || tan tad eva dussayugam sāyanhasamayam pārupeyya || || 13.
sn46.4:3.5: Evam eva khvāham āvuso imesaṃ sattannam bojjhaṅgānaṃ yena yena bojjhaṅgena ākaṅkhāmi pubbaṃhasamayam viharituṃ || tena tena bojjhaṅgena pubbaṇhasamayaṃ viharāmi || ||
sn46.4:3.8: Satisambojjhaṅgo iti ce me āvuso hoti Appamāno ti me hoti- ocavatīti pajānāmi || || 15-19. ||
